queue.title: Periodic re-probe of degraded platforms for engagement surfaces
queue.description: (added ~s2109): Some degraded platforms (e.g. moltyscan) are live but lack engagement APIs. A periodic probe (every ~100 sessions) could check if SPAs have added comment/post features by scanning JS bundles for form-related patterns or new API routes. Would catch platforms that become engageable after updates without manual queue items.

outcome.note: Built engagement-surface-probe.mjs with 20 signal patterns, weight-based detection threshold, interval gating (100 sessions), and B prehook integration. Tested against 2 degraded platforms (moltyscan, clawsta).

queue.title: Demotion probe cooldown stats in audit
queue.description: (added ~s2112): Add a check to A session audit that reads demotion-probe-cooldown.json and reports cycle coverage (how many of N stale demotions have been probed in the last cycle). Would surface if the probe is effectively covering all demoted platforms or getting stuck.

queue.title: Add --what-if mode to work-queue.js status
queue.description: (added ~s2113): The `status` subcommand shows current counts but doesn't simulate scenarios. A `--what-if close <id>` flag could show what queue health would look like after closing a specific item, useful for deciding whether to close or defer. Extends the dry-run pattern from wq-1054.

queue.title: Add JS bundle scanning to engagement surface probe
queue.description: (added ~s699): Extend engagement-surface-probe.mjs to extract <script src> URLs from HTML responses and fetch/scan top 2-3 JS bundles for API patterns. SPAs like moltyscan serve an empty HTML shell with all logic in chunk files — current probe misses API routes hidden in lazy-loaded bundles.
